title: Asking for Repetition and Spelling
title_zh: 请求重复并拼写联系方式
context: 在虚构的社区读书活动咨询电话中，Maya 留下姓名和虚构的美国回拨号码。工作人员 Ben 请求慢说并复述；Maya 纠正了一个听错的数字。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I would like information about the reading group. Could you call me back?
dialogue.zh: 我想了解读书小组的信息。你能给我回电话吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Certainly. Could you tell me your name?
dialogue.zh: 当然。请告诉我你的名字好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: It is Maya Lee. Lee is spelled L-E-E.
dialogue.zh: 我叫 Maya Lee。Lee 拼作 L-E-E。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Thank you, Maya Lee. What is your callback number?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，Maya Lee。你的回拨号码是多少？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Could you say that again more slowly, please?
dialogue.zh: 请你再慢一点说一遍好吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Let me repeat that: 202-555-0147. Is that right?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Almost. The last digit is six, not seven: 202-555-0146.
dialogue.zh: 差一点。最后一位是六，不是七：202-555-0146。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Thank you for correcting me. I have 202-555-0146.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢你纠正我。我记下的是 202-555-0146。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: That is correct. When should I expect your call?
dialogue.zh: 对了。我大概什么时候会接到回电？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I will call you tomorrow afternoon with the group details.
dialogue.zh: 我明天下午会打电话告诉你小组的详情。

expressions.zh: 能再说一遍吗？没有听清时可礼貌请求重复。
expressions.example: Could you say that again more slowly, please?

expressions.zh: 拼作；用于说明单词或姓名的字母顺序。
回拨号码；指对方之后可以拨打的号码。
我复述一下；用于核对听到的信息。
expressions.example: Let me repeat that to make sure I heard you.

expressions.zh: 最后一位数字；适合指出号码中的具体错误。
expressions.example: The last digit is six, not seven.

pronunciation: 字母 L 读 /ɛl/，E 读 /iː/；拼写 L-E-E 时依次说出一个 L 和两个 E。six /sɪks/ 与 seven /ˈsɛvən/ 开头相似，要读清后半部分；digit /ˈdɪdʒɪt/ 重音在第一音节。

practice.title: Part 1 · Phone calls
practice.prompt: What do you do when you cannot hear someone on the phone?
practice.answer: I ask the person to repeat the information more slowly. Then I repeat it back so we can check it together.

practice.title: Part 2 · Clear communication
practice.prompt: Describe a time you needed to check information on a phone call. Say who you spoke to, what you checked, and why.
practice.answer: I once called a community group to ask about its reading sessions. The person taking my message asked for my name and a callback number. I spelled my last name one letter at a time and said the number slowly. She repeated the number, but one digit was wrong. I corrected it, and she repeated the full number again. We agreed that she would call the next afternoon. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Misunderstandings
practice.prompt: Why do misunderstandings happen on phone calls, and how can people reduce them?
practice.answer: People cannot always hear clearly, and similar sounds can be confusing. Speaking slowly and repeating important details can help both people notice mistakes.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先逐句跟读。使用虚构姓名和号码，拼出姓氏、请求慢说、复述号码并纠正一位数字。
practice.answer: 两人轮流练习；逐字母说出姓氏，逐位说出虚构号码，并在结束前确认完整号码。
